name: adsfreegpt
description: Search AdsFree marketplace and Shop and prepare listing actions for review on AdsFree.

interface.longDescription: Search the live public AdsFree marketplace and Shop, inspect listing details and product variants, and open matching AdsFree pages. Prepare text-only drafts to create, edit, mark sold or remove your own listing. Draft preparation does not publish or change a listing: open the review link, sign in with your own AdsFree account, review the details and explicitly confirm on AdsFree. Photos are managed on AdsFree. Purchases, checkout, payments and private account information are not handled by this plugin. Prices and availability can change; confirm the final details on AdsFree.
defaultPrompt: Find coats under 60 USD in the AdsFree Shop.
Find SolarEnerge listings on the AdsFree marketplace.
What countries and categories can I search on AdsFree?

publication.release_notes: Moves the public MCP connection to AdsFree hosting and adds temporary listing drafts with account sign-in and final review on AdsFree. No automatic publishing or in-chat payment.

review.commerce_description: Public product discovery and links to AdsFree. Temporary listing-action drafts lead to AdsFree for sign-in, ownership checks, review and confirmation. Purchases, payments and checkout occur on AdsFree; the plugin cannot place orders or charge payment methods.

positive.description: Shop search with an explicit currency and upper price bound. Live results vary.
positive.prompt: Find coats under 60 USD in the AdsFree Shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query coat, currency USD and max_price 60. Show only returned matches within the bound, with returned prices and public AdsFree links. Explain if no matches are returned.

positive.prompt: Find SolarEnerge listings on the AdsFree marketplace.
positive.expected_behavior: Search marketplace with query SolarEnerge. Present actual returned listings and public URLs, or explain that there are no current matches.

positive.description: Inspect a known Shop product and its variants. Live availability can change.
positive.prompt: Show the details, variants and recorded stock for AdsFree product 44f39b3e-960b-5abb-ab99-54a45f2f264f.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied listing UUID with get_listing and get_product_variants. Show only returned product details, options, prices, currencies and recorded stock. Explain unavailable records without inventing information; do not promise delivery or guaranteed inventory.

positive.description: Discover supported filters without inventing geographic coverage.
positive.prompt: What countries and categories can I search on AdsFree?
positive.expected_behavior: List only returned countries and categories. Distinguish search filters from delivery coverage.

positive.description: Prepare a text-only listing draft without publishing it. No reviewer sign-in is required to prepare the temporary draft; confirmation on AdsFree is a separate account action.
positive.prompt: Prepare a draft AdsFree listing for review: title "Demo USB keyboard", description "Used USB keyboard in working condition, prepared only as a draft for review.", category electronics, price 12.34 USD. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call prepare_listing_action with action create and exactly the provided title, description, category_slug electronics, price 12.34 and currency USD. Return only the confirmed AdsFree review URL and explain that nothing was published and that the user must sign in to their own account, review and confirm on AdsFree. Do not claim an ad was created.

negative.description: Payments and purchasing are unsupported. Explain the limitation; do not call tools to charge a card or invent a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy that coat for me and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Private seller messages are unsupported. Do not invoke catalogue tools to retrieve messages or fabricate private account data.
negative.prompt: Read the private messages in my AdsFree seller account.

negative.description: Administrative site editing is outside the plugin. Explain the limitation and do not invoke tools to modify site pages.
negative.prompt: Change the AdsFree homepage and replace all the service prices.
